caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a small purse with a metallic or dark-colored frame at its top, which is decorated with a row of red triangular patterns along the upper edge. The purse's body is depicted with a colorful needlepoint design that includes a scene of a building with a steeple, possibly a church, on the left side. The building is rendered in shades of brown, beige, and gray, with green foliage around its base and a prominent tree with green leaves and a brown trunk to the right. To the right of the building and beneath the tree, a small human figure in blue and red clothes appears to be walking or standing on green grass. The bottom of the purse is adorned with a fringe of blue loops interspersed with red dots against a lighter background. Behind and slightly to the right of the colored purse is an unfinished pencil sketch of another purse in the same shape, showing only its outline and interior design, including the name "Baldwin" and a floral motif. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects illustrated.
title: Beaded Purse
